change_definition.current_behavior: Plan-mode prompt-type skills may stop with chat-only handoff or Cursor .cursor/plans output. session-handoff.md is created mainly by @handoff; plan skills do not record required, optional, and recommendation steps in a durable handoff when PLAN.md changes. prompt-execution-mode stop rule does not gate on disk.
change_definition.desired_behavior: session-handoff.md Plan execution steps subsection is the primary record for required, optional, and recommendation steps created or modified during plan execution. Plan leaves create or update that subsection when PLAN changes; working PLAN.md remains canonical implementation plan; @handoff still owns full session log merge. Leaf skills and subagent contracts enforce disk before stop.
success_criteria: session-handoff-structure.md defines Plan execution steps with required, optional, recommendations, changelog

unchanged_behavior: @handoff boundaries vs close-out and DAE handoffs
